pdf.note: Byte-identical to the file hashed in data/sources.json (retrieved 2026-07-12); the same bytes were served on 2026-08-21.

ocr.method: Pages rendered at 300 dpi with pdftoppm (poppler) and recognised with macOS Vision VNRecognizeTextRequest (accurate level, language correction off). Unedited machine output, ordered top to bottom per page.

text.method: The OCR file with the reviewed corrections in corrections.json applied, in order. scripts/verify-corpus.mjs reproduces this file from the other two and fails if the hashes drift.

authority: The signed scan is the source. The text files exist so that a quotation can be checked mechanically; where they and the image differ, the image controls, and a reader should verify against the PDF page.
